description: Azure DevOps CLI (azdo) for work items, pull requests, pipelines, relations, attachments and authentication
rules: docs/commands.md is the command reference; every azdo subcommand, option and --json shape is listed there and checked against the real command tree by tests/unit/docs-command-reference.test.ts.
Sign in with `azdo auth login`; there is no `azdo login`, `azdo work-item` or `azdo boards` command. Read a work item with `azdo get-item <id>`.

Credentials resolve AZDO_PAT env var -> stored credential (OS credential store, or DPAPI files when credentialStore=dpapi) -> AZDO_PAT in a .env file; AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT and similar variables are ignored.
`azdo pr open` always targets the develop branch.
Machine-readable output: pass --json; the JSON goes to stdout, errors to stderr.
